notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
description:
Play Arid Archway.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it, Sarinth Greatwurm, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Arid Archway trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Sarinth Greatwurm trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Arid Archway from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Arid Archway enters the battlefield, it and Sarinth Greatwurm trigger.
Repeat from step 4.
